title: Diversity Day
description: After Michael's own insensitive joke gets the branch in trouble, a corporate-mandated diversity seminar goes sideways when Michael decides to run his own version of it instead.

title: The Dundies
description: Michael takes the staff to a nearby restaurant for the office's own homegrown awards show, determined to give everyone a night to remember.

title: The Fire
description: A small fire breaks out in the break room, and the resulting evacuation gives several coworkers a block of unsupervised downtime to work through their own anxieties and jealousies.

title: Email Surveillance
description: New email monitoring lets Michael discover that Jim is hosting a party he wasn't invited to, and he can't resist finding a way to show up anyway.

title: Christmas Party
description: Michael scraps the office's planned Secret Santa in favor of a cutthroat Yankee Swap, and the mix-up over gifts ends up revealing more about everyone's relationships than intended.

title: Booze Cruise
description: The branch takes an awkward team-building trip aboard a booze cruise, where Michael's attempt to bond with the staff competes with Jim's growing feelings for Pam.

title: The Secret
description: After accidentally letting slip that someone in the office has a crush, Michael's clumsy attempt to keep things quiet only makes everyone more suspicious of each other.

title: Valentine's Day
description: Michael's Valentine's Day is derailed by a breakup, while the office puts together a short in-house film that ends up revealing a surprising amount about the people who made it.

title: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
description: The office fills up with employees' kids for the day, and Michael's attempt to entertain them with a talent show reveals just how much he craves everyone's approval.

title: Michael's Birthday
description: Michael expects a big office celebration for his birthday, and his growing disappointment when it doesn't materialize pushes him into some increasingly odd behavior.

title: Initiation
description: Dwight puts the new temp through a strange rite of passage out at the family beet farm, while back at the office a sugar-fueled holiday sends Michael's afternoon off the rails.

title: The Merger
description: Staff from a shuttered branch join the Scranton office, and Michael's homemade welcome efforts make the transition far more awkward than it needed to be.

title: A Benihana Christmas
description: Michael brings two dates to the office Christmas party while Angela and Pam wage a quiet battle over whose party decorations and traditions will win out.

title: Traveling Salesmen
description: Michael pairs off different salespeople for a day of client visits, and the odd pairings expose some unexpected tension and camaraderie among the sales team.

title: Cocktails
description: Michael and the staff attend Jan's dinner party, where tensions boil over and a few uncomfortable truths come out after one too many cocktails.

title: Goodbye, Toby
description: On Toby's last day before moving to Costa Rica, Michael throws him a going-away party he can barely bring himself to attend, while a major relationship milestone unfolds elsewhere in the office.

title: Weight Loss
description: The branch takes on a months-long weight-loss competition tied to the company's health plan, while Michael quietly starts a long-distance relationship with the corporate HR representative.

title: Business Ethics
description: A workplace-ethics seminar turns into an uncomfortable confession circle, while Jim sets out to log exactly how much company time Dwight spends on personal business.

title: Employee Transfer
description: Corporate moves Holly to another branch, so Michael and Darryl drive her there themselves on a road trip that becomes one long, reluctant goodbye.

title: Stress Relief
description: Dwight's overzealous fire-safety drill traumatizes the office, prompting corporate to send in a stress-management specialist whose techniques go over about as well as you'd expect.

title: Café Disco
description: Michael turns an empty office downstairs into a dance spot to lift everyone's mood, while Jim and Pam rethink how they want to get married.

title: Niagara
description: Jim and Pam's wedding weekend at Niagara Falls is upended by travel chaos and old grudges, even as the ceremony itself still manages to come together.

title: Sabre
description: A new parent company arrives with strict rules and a painfully earnest welcome video, while Michael and Jim seek out a former boss for advice on the new regime.

title: St. Patrick's Day
description: The CEO's extended stay in Scranton collides with Jim's first day back from paternity leave, and Michael's holiday plans depend on whether she'll let everyone go home.

title: Nepotism
description: Michael refuses to fire his hopelessly unhelpful nephew, even as the rest of the office grows more and more fed up with the new hire.

title: Costume Contest
description: A Halloween costume contest with an underwhelming prize turns surprisingly competitive, while Michael comes face to face with a salesman he once considered his biggest rival.

title: The Seminar
description: Andy hosts a seminar for local small-business owners and recruits his coworkers as guest speakers, with predictably uneven results.

title: Goodbye, Michael
description: Michael quietly wraps up his final day at the branch ahead of schedule, slipping away to say a real goodbye to Pam before anyone else realizes he's leaving for good.

title: Garden Party
description: Andy throws a formal garden party at his parents' home to impress the new CEO, and Dwight relies on an etiquette guide that isn't quite what it claims to be.

title: Doomsday
description: Dwight sets up a system that will report the office to the CEO if too many mistakes pile up, leaving everyone scrambling to get through a flawless day.

title: Lice
description: An outbreak of lice sweeps through the office and suspicion lands on the wrong person, while the real source tries hard to keep a low profile.

title: Customer Loyalty
description: A work trip makes Jim miss an important family moment, putting fresh strain on things at home, while Dwight and Darryl take a road trip of their own.

title: The Farm
description: A death in the family brings Dwight back together with his estranged siblings, and he tries to convince them to stay and run the family farm with him.

title: Finale
description: A year after the documentary airs, the whole extended Dunder Mifflin family reunites in Scranton for a panel discussion and one last chance to reflect on their years together.
